c: Bones : water ≈ 1 : 1.5 by weight; mirepoix 10% of bone weight; bouquet garni; no salt.
Simmer (80–90 °C, never boil): fish 25–30 min · chicken 3–4 h · duck/pork 4–5 h · veal/beef 8–10 h · vegetable 45 min · shellfish 40 min.
Yield ≈ 60–70% of water added; remouillage (second extraction) only for staff meal or reduction to glace.
Blanch white-stock bones from cold water, rinse; brown bones 220 °C 40 min for brown stocks, tomato paste last 10 min.
Skim scum every 15 min in the first hour, then fat; never stir; strain through chinois + muslin without pressing.
Cooling: 60 → 10 °C ≤ 90 min (ice bath, shallow containers); log on the cooling form.
Store 0–4 °C max 3 days; reboil to 100 °C before use; freeze in labelled 1 L / 5 L bags.
de477b50.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Reference card.

c: Lean minced protein 10% of stock weight (chicken, beef, fish to match stock), egg whites 5%, fine mirepoix 10%, acid (tomato).
Mix raft with a little ice-cold stock; whisk into cold, fat-free stock (≤ 10 °C).
Heat slowly, stirring gently until 55 °C; stop stirring; raft rises and sets at 70 °C; open a vent; simmer 85 °C 1–1.5 h.
Ladle through the vent via muslin; degrease with paper; season at the end.
Cloudy = boiled or stirred after setting, fatty stock; rescue: cool to 10 °C, re-clarify with 3% egg white.
Alternatives: gelatin/agar freeze-thaw filtration (vegetarian, no protein loss).
